text: Anyone coming to the 7am tmrw?
7am is basically midnight for me but yes. Setting two alarms
I'll be there. 7 is the good hour before the kites come out
In. Have to leave by 8 for school tho
Ok so we do the loop and you peel off early
[photo: last of the chillies on the windowsill]
Pulled the plants today. Bit sad
Deck is due at 6 and my manager just said "quick change" which means it's 40 slides now
Ugh good luck. I'm stuck on a reconciliation that's off by exactly NT$300, will find it by 6 or die
Mine just burned a whole tray of rice kitchen smells for hours
Does anyone know if the fountain at the north entrance is still off
Saw the sign this morning, off til friday I think. They're cleaning the pump
Perfect so the dogs just have to drink from the puddle again
Amy did you find the 300
Found it. Transposed digits. Of course
Good. See you at 7 then
Deck's sent. Don't ask me how many slides
Leaving now. Cold enough that I'm wearing Ben's scarf
Up. Barely
Back at the car. Dog was not impressed by the cold but walked the whole loop
Bus is late so I'm standing here. Tell me if anyone sees a kite before 8
Didn't see a kite. Saw a guy try to walk 4 dogs on one leash
That's the 7:15 guy. He had two last month
[photo: bulbul on the feeder by the back fence]
Didn't even have to put seed out, it just came
Lunch is a sad sandwich at my desk. Client is still asking why the March figures moved
Because they were wrong in March, that's why
Manager says deck is fine but wants the appendix moved to the front
Tell him the appendix can be the front if he wants
Ha
Amy is the fountain still off or did they finish
Still off. Sign says Friday, the pump part is coming from Kaohsiung
So Friday, the puddle again
Year-end close is next week and I'm already tired
Going to bed early, 7 again tomorrow. Please someone be on time
Will be. Early is the only way I know
Can't sleep. Will set two alarms again
Leaving. Ben's scarf again
Alarm 1 ignored. Alarm 2 worked. Walking now
Here. Two kites already, no fight yet
Where's Sandy
Here. Bus was on time for once. Dog is already ahead of me
Guy with 4 dogs is back
He's late. Probably the 4 dogs slowed him
Peeling off now. Son has a test at 8:30 he says he hasn't studied for
Good luck to him
[photo: the bed by the fence, turned over]
Garlic goes in here in a few weeks
Manager changed his mind. Appendix is back at the back
Told you the appendix can go wherever
Client has moved on to asking about bank fees. Every week it's a new line
Bank fees are the real enemy
My son asked if the dog walkers have a group name. I said no. He is disappointed
The 7 o'clock club
Too early for me. It's the 8am club or nothing
Bed. See you all at 7
Deck v2 sent at midnight. Hopefully manager sleeps before he reads it
Can't sleep again
